edbDesc: (or mass moment of inertia, rotational inertia, polar moment of inertia of mass, or the angular mass). The inertia of a rotating body with respect to its rotation. The moment of inertia plays much the same role in rotational dynamics as mass does in linear dynamics,
title: Moment of Inertia
pickWhy: A quantity (rotational mass), not an effect; the job it does in flywheels is ordinary inertia, covered by Laws of motion.
